name: Cart PDF – Quote PDF for WooCommerce + Drag and Drop Template Builder
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
Document: https://pdf.add-ons.org/document-pdf-invoices-packing-slips-for-woocommerce-drag-and-drop-template-builder/
Demo: https://demo.add-ons.org/cartpdf/cart/?add-to-cart=19,20,26,27

Cart PDF – Quote PDF for WooCommerce is an all-in-one solution designed to empower online stores, B2B wholesale merchants, and service businesses. Customers can download their shopping cart as a professional PDF document, generate single product spec sheets, or request a formal price quote in just one click.

With the intuitive Drag & Drop Visual Template Builder, you can easily customize invoices, cart summaries, product brochures, and quotation documents to match your brand without writing a single line of code.

Key Features

1. Cart, Checkout & Single Product Page Placement

  • Instant Cart Summary PDF: Customers can download a complete PDF summary of their cart (product names, thumbnails, SKUs, quantities, variations, item prices, taxes, discounts, and totals).
  • Single Product Page PDF & Quote: Allow shoppers to download a product PDF spec sheet or request a quote directly from any single product page—without needing to add the item to their cart first!
  • Multiple Hook Placements on Product Page: Choose exactly where buttons appear (Inside product summary, above Add to Cart form, below Add to Cart button, or after product summary).
  • Checkout Page Support: Display download or quote buttons directly on the Checkout page for customers who want to save order details before paying.
  • Custom Button Styling: Customize button text, colors, icons, and CSS classes to seamlessly blend with your store theme.

2. B2B Request a Quote System

  • One-Click Quote Requests: Customers can submit quote requests from the Cart, Checkout, or Single Product page.
  • Single Product Quote Capture: Automatically captures selected product variations and quantities when requested directly from a product page.
  • Interactive Popup Modal: Collect essential customer details such as Full Name, Email, Phone number, Company, and Special Notes/Instructions.
  • Quote Management in Admin: Quotes are saved into a dedicated backend management dashboard (Custom Post Type) with customer contact information, itemized products, and quote statuses.
  • Restore Cart from Quote: Customers or sales reps can reopen and restore items from a saved quote back into the cart for instant checkout.

3. Automated Email Notifications with PDF Quote Attached

  • Customer Confirmation Email: Automatically sends a polished email to the customer with their official Price Quote PDF attached.
  • Admin Notification Alert: Notifies store managers and sales teams immediately whenever a new quote request is submitted.
  • Custom Email Templates: Integrated into WooCommerce standard emails with customizable subject lines, email headers, and body content.

4. Visual Drag-and-Drop Template Builder

  • Intuitive Editor: Design and arrange PDF layouts visually with live real-time previews.
  • Rich Component Library: Add product tables, logo images, header/footer text, billing/shipping addresses, QR codes, barcodes, divider lines, and page breaks.
  • Dynamic Shortcodes: Insert WooCommerce dynamic tags for store info, customer details, tax breakdowns, and coupon details.
  • Print-Ready Documents: Generates clean, high-resolution (300 DPI) PDF files ready for printing or digital archiving.

5. Gutenberg Block & Shortcode Integration

  • Native Gutenberg Block: Includes the “Cart Download PDF” block for easy placement anywhere using the WordPress Block Editor (FSE & Block themes).
  • Flexible Shortcode: Use [cart_pdf_button] to place download or quote buttons inside custom landing pages, Elementor, Divi, or sidebar widgets.
  • Classic & Block Theme Ready: Works out of the box with classic themes like Storefront, Astra, OceanWP, as well as modern Full Site Editing (FSE) themes.

6. Multilingual & RTL Font Support

  • RTL Language Compatibility: Fully compatible with Right-to-Left scripts like Arabic, Persian, and Hebrew.
  • Global Character Support: Embedded UTF-8 fonts supporting complex characters including Thai, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, and Korean.

Benefits for Your Store

  • Empower B2B & Wholesale Sales: Provide corporate clients and purchasing departments with formal quotes for offline managerial approval.
  • Single Product Spec Sheets: Perfect for technical, high-value, or custom products where buyers need downloadable datasheets.
  • Reduce Cart Abandonment: Let customers save their cart contents as a PDF to review and purchase later.
  • Save Time & Labor: Eliminate manual quotation creation; the system generates, formats, and emails PDF quotes automatically.
  • Professional Brand Image: Deliver crisp, elegant PDF documents with your company logo, terms, and conditions.

WooCommerce PDF Cart Keywords

sections.installation:
1. Upload the cart-pdf-for-woocommerce directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly via the WordPress Admin Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Cart PDF & Quote to configure Cart, Checkout, and Single Product page display options.
  4. Customize your PDF template under the PDF Template Builder menu.
  5. Your customers can now download PDFs and request quotes from Cart, Checkout, and Single Product pages!
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Added: Single Product Page integration tab (Download PDF & Request a Quote directly from product pages).
  • Added: Full B2B “Request a Quote” system with popup modal and backend quote management.
  • Added: WooCommerce automated email notifications with PDF quote attachment.
  • Added: Native Gutenberg Block (“Cart Download PDF”) for Block themes and Full Site Editing.
  • Added: Support for checkout page placement.
  • Added: Restore cart from quote feature.
  • Improved: Enhanced PDF rendering engine and RTL/Multilingual font support.
  • Improved: Theme integration guide for Storefront, classic, and block themes.

1.1.1

  • Added: Button download option on the WooCommerce Checkout page.

1.0.2

  • Fixed: Initial setup and settings loading.

1.0.1

  • Initial release with Drag-and-Drop Cart PDF Template Builder.
